ordinary_step_current_report.short_stop_cause: Homing attempt: no-contact short stop with driver-reported completion; mechanism/drive/threshold cause unresolved. Do not attribute to the ordinary160-pulse target.
ordinary_step_current_report.interpretation: User later confirmed the trigger was home_request, consistent with home8/1/226ms and ordinary motion zeros. This supersedes the initial ordinary-step attribution. The brief13mA display sample is not an independently measured steady/peak current or justification for a new threshold.

ordinary_motion_watch_followup.interpretation: No retained ordinary-motion start/result is shown. In the current source, a consumed ordinary start makes state nonzero, and completed/failed states remain nonzero; normal completion does not reset them to zero. Wrong request entry, reset/session mismatch, upstream request suppression or firmware mismatch remain possibilities. Home8/1/226ms cannot establish ordinary160-pulse execution. Do not attribute the observed brief movement or 13mA to a verified ordinary-step run.
ordinary_motion_watch_followup.source_review: App_ArmSequenceGuard and active Carrier can clear an ordinary start request before Extension_MotionService. This is a possible path, not a confirmed current interlock cause.

ordinary_motion_failure_observation.interpretation: Ordinary motion now reached the state machine and latched result5, a driver-state check failure rather than result3 timeout or result1 completion. Nonzero delta is a raw feedback change, not21 pulses/mm and not physical retraction acceptance. In current unchanged source, nonzero delta after reset-to-zero at acceptance points to the motion-monitoring path; its status check rejects stall/protection bits or missing enable. Exact flags, retained reply and stop acknowledgement remain unseen; no mechanical jam, driver protection, wiring or power root cause is yet confirmed.
ordinary_motion_failure_observation.source_response: Extension_MotionFault(5) attempts the ordinary stop command and latches9/5. Attempting stop is not proof of acknowledgement or physical stop; g_extension_stop_result must be read. Do not clear this latch or retrigger before preserving fields.

ordinary_stall_flag_followup.manufacturer_reference: Archived X-series V2 Rev1.0 section7.4.4 status3A and OLED Clog_Pro/Clog_Ma/O_SL_Ma descriptions. Manufacturer protocol facts are not competition R.
ordinary_stall_flag_followup.interpretation: The drive reported stall while still enabled and not in-position. Protection bit was not set in this captured reply; this does not prove protection is configured off. Current host code checks the instantaneous stall bit and sends stop on it; the ordinary stop exchange returned1. Root cause of reported stall remains unresolved: mechanical resistance, wiring/torque/current or detection parameters cannot be distinguished yet. Stop command ACK is not an independent physical-stop or safe-handling guarantee.
ordinary_stall_flag_followup.separate_thresholds: Clog_Ma is the general stall-detection current threshold; O_SL_Ma is the sensorless-home collision current threshold. The previously read800mA belongs to the latter, not a verified Clog_Ma value.
ordinary_stall_flag_followup.clog_ma_value_source: User replied 是2200 to the explicit Clog_Ma query; oral confirmation, no menu screenshot or CAN parameter readback supplied. No parameter change requested/performed.
